2f41838.summary: Keeps the Pack trait buff in sync with the number of friendly troops: in hand it only strips this card's own pack buffs; in play it rebuilds a +N/+N pack buff when the troop count changed. The tail is an inlined AddEffect that applies the new buff and refreshes figures and combos.

In play: work out how many other friendly troops the pack counts

Nothing to do if the count is invalid or unchanged since the last time

New buff is an extrinsic addStats effect: +N melee and +N ranged attack, where N is the troop count

setCost replaces any existing cost override and refreshes the cost text
setCurrentHealth: may trigger Ecstasy, then jumps to the shared health-setting code

Mid-range buff types: replaceAbility and addStatsDropPod

addStatsDropPod: add health and attack to the separate drop pod stat counters
Main buff type switch

Look for an existing effect for the same trait to merge with (stack counts or keep the higher value)

Per-trait side effects: Flank/Fast refresh summon sickness anims

Gaining Survivor clears the survivor-spent marker

Markerlight and Hunt Mark announce themselves to the battle manager
If the card is in play, play the trait's animation, then refresh icons
Case 4: removeTrait buff; Stealth loss is broadcast, then the trait is removed

Warlord swap attempt: log an error message instead
Cases 6 and 0x1e: set-stats buffs clear earlier ones and all extrinsic effects, then add this one
Case 8: apply a Mark of Chaos enchantment to this card and broadcast it
Case 9: set health to a fixed value; may trigger Ecstasy, then refresh health text
Case 0xb: remove extrinsic effects coming from the enchanting card
Cases 0xc/0xf: plain enchantments
Case 0x10: add an active enchantment, with special handling by the enchantment's id
Quest enchantment (id 0x78): replace any earlier quest effect, reset the quest counter
Secret enchantment (id 0x3c) is flagged as a secret buff
Mutation (id 0x82): spend and trigger the enchantment immediately
Mark of Chaos enchantments (ids 0xbe/0x8c): spend, trigger and broadcast
Case 0x11: re-trigger the last Mark of Chaos on this card
Case 0x19: reflected copy becomes ephemeral
Case 0x1e shares the set-stats code below
Case 0x23: daemon host buff type is not implemented
Common end: refresh displayed numbers, then check for possible card combinations
